ex.en: You'd better wear a sweater under your jacket.
ex.zh: 你最好在外套裡面加件毛衣。

ex.en: What do you think of this sweater?
ex.zh: 你覺得這件毛衣怎麼樣？

ex.en: That red sweater looks good on you.
ex.zh: 你穿那件紅毛衣很好看。

sweater.en: a warm piece of knitted clothing for the upper body

ex.en: I swapped a camera for a guitar.
ex.zh: 我用一台相機換了一把吉他。

ex.en: Can we swap seats?
ex.zh: 我們可以換個座位嗎？

ex.en: Let's swap shifts this weekend.
ex.zh: 這個週末我們換班吧。

swap.en: to give something to someone and get something else from them in return

ex.en: We arranged a shift swap with our coworkers.
ex.zh: 我們和同事安排了換班。

ex.en: The clothing swap event was a big success.
ex.zh: 換衣活動非常成功。

swap.en: an act of giving one thing and getting another thing in return

ex.en: A swallow flies very swiftly.
ex.zh: 燕子飛得非常快。

ex.en: With a glance of her, he left swiftly.
ex.zh: 他看了她一眼，就迅速離開了。

ex.en: The company acted swiftly to fix the problem.
ex.zh: 公司迅速採取行動解決問題。

ex.en: My hands and legs are swollen.
ex.zh: 我的手腳都腫了。

ex.en: How long have your cheeks been swollen?
ex.zh: 你的臉頰腫多久了？

swell.en: to become larger or rounder than normal, especially because of injury or illness

ex.en: Our surplus has swelled by nearly ten percent in this quarter.
ex.zh: 本季我們的盈餘增加了將近一成。

ex.en: The crowd swelled to over 10,000 people.
ex.zh: 人潮增加到一萬多人。

swell.en: to become bigger in size, number or amount

ex.en: I swam very well when I was a child.
ex.zh: 我小時候很會游泳。

ex.en: My younger brother swims every day in the summer.
ex.zh: 我弟弟夏天每天都去游泳。

ex.en: Who is the boy that is swimming over there?
ex.zh: 在那裡游泳的男孩是誰？

swim.en: to move through water by using your arms and legs

ex.en: Let's go for a swim after work.
ex.zh: 下班後我們去游個泳吧。

ex.en: I had a swim in the hotel pool.
ex.zh: 我在飯店的泳池游了泳。

swim.en: a period of time spent moving through water for fun or exercise

ex.en: Tom and Mary switched places on the bench.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗在長椅上換了位子。

ex.en: Many customers have switched to online banking.
ex.zh: 許多客戶已經改用網路銀行。

switch.en: to change from one thing to another, or to exchange one thing for another

switch.zh: switch on / off：打開／關掉（電器）

ex.en: Switch off the light. I can't get to sleep.
ex.zh: 把燈關掉，我睡不著。

ex.en: I was hot, so I switched on the fan.
ex.zh: 我很熱，所以打開了電風扇。

ex.en: I forgot to save the file before switching off.
ex.zh: 我關機前忘了存檔。

switch.en: to start or stop a machine or light by pressing a button or moving a control

ex.en: She groped for the light switch in the dark.
ex.zh: 她在黑暗中摸索電燈開關。

ex.en: The light switch is next to the door.
ex.zh: 電燈開關在門旁邊。

switch.en: a small control that you press or move to turn a machine or light on or off

ex.en: The switch to the new system went smoothly.
ex.zh: 換成新系統的過程很順利。

ex.en: She made the switch from sales to marketing.
ex.zh: 她從業務轉調到行銷部門。

switch.en: a change from one thing to another

ex.en: Those grapes look sweet, but in fact they're sour.
ex.zh: 那些葡萄看起來很甜，其實是酸的。

ex.en: I don't like drinking beverages that are too sweet.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡喝太甜的飲料。

ex.en: When it comes to sweets, I just can't control myself.
ex.zh: 一看到甜食，我就控制不了自己。

ex.en: According to dentists, tooth decay is not always caused by sweets.
ex.zh: 根據牙醫的說法，蛀牙不一定是甜食造成的。

sweet.en: small pieces of sugary food that you eat for pleasure

ex.en: It's so sweet of you to remember my birthday.
ex.zh: 你記得我的生日，真貼心。

ex.en: What a sweet little dog!
ex.zh: 好可愛的小狗！

sweet.en: kind and thoughtful, or pleasant and lovely

ex.en: Chris swung his sword!
ex.zh: 克里斯揮了一下劍。

ex.en: He swung the bat and hit the ball.
ex.zh: 他揮棒擊中了球。

swing.en: to move back and forth or in a curve while hanging or held from one point

ex.en: The kids are playing on the swings.
ex.zh: 孩子們在盪鞦韆。

ex.en: There is a swing in our backyard.
ex.zh: 我們後院有一座鞦韆。

swing.en: a seat hanging from ropes that a person sits on and moves back and forth

ex.en: Mennad always has those mood swings.
ex.zh: 梅納德的情緒總是起伏很大。

ex.en: There was a big swing in oil prices this year.
ex.zh: 今年油價波動很大。

swing.en: a sudden change from one state or level to another

ex.en: My father is sweeping the garage.
ex.zh: 我爸正在掃車庫。

ex.en: Don't forget to sweep the kitchen clean.
ex.zh: 別忘了把廚房掃乾淨。

sweep.en: to clean a floor by pushing dirt away with a brush

ex.en: A blast of cold air swept through the house.
ex.zh: 一陣冷風吹過整間房子。

ex.en: Tsunamis swept through rice fields and flooded the towns.
ex.zh: 海嘯席捲稻田，淹沒了城鎮。

sweep.en: to move quickly and strongly across or through a place

ex.en: I swear I will never do such a thing.
ex.zh: 我發誓絕對不會做這種事。

ex.en: The knight swore an oath of allegiance to the king.
ex.zh: 騎士宣誓效忠國王。

ex.en: I swear I didn't tell anyone your secret.
ex.zh: 我發誓我沒把你的秘密告訴任何人。

swear.en: to make a serious promise that you are telling the truth or will do something

ex.en: Tom can't go three sentences without swearing.
ex.zh: 湯姆講不到三句話就會罵髒話。

ex.en: Please don't swear in front of the kids.
ex.zh: 請不要在孩子面前罵髒話。

swear.en: to use rude or offensive words, usually because you are angry (offensive)

ex.en: I don't have a sword.
ex.zh: 我沒有劍。

ex.en: This sword has a strange history.
ex.zh: 這把劍有一段奇特的歷史。

sword.en: a weapon with a long sharp metal blade and a handle

ex.en: Social media is a double-edged sword.
ex.zh: 社群媒體是一把雙面刃。

ex.en: Fame can be a double-edged sword.
ex.zh: 名氣可能是一把雙面刃。

sword.en: something that has both good and bad effects

ex.en: Progress was swift.
ex.zh: 進展很快。

ex.en: The stream is not very swift.
ex.zh: 水流不太湍急。

ex.en: Thank you for your swift reply.
ex.zh: 謝謝您迅速的回覆。

ex.en: He lives alone in a little cottage in the swamp.
ex.zh: 他獨自住在沼澤裡的一間小屋。

ex.en: Many birds live in the swamp.
ex.zh: 許多鳥類住在這片沼澤裡。

swamp.en: an area of soft wet land with many plants growing in it

swamp.zh: 使應接不暇、使忙不過來；淹沒

ex.en: I don't mean to swamp you.
ex.zh: 我不是故意要讓你忙不過來。

ex.en: We've been swamped with orders this week.
ex.zh: 這週我們的訂單多到忙不過來。

swamp.en: to give someone so much to deal with that they cannot cope, or to cover with water

ex.en: I can't swallow these tablets without a drink of water.
ex.zh: 不喝水的話，我吞不下這些藥片。

ex.en: Food should be chewed before being swallowed.
ex.zh: 食物要先嚼過再吞下去。

ex.en: It hurts when I swallow because of my sore throat.
ex.zh: 我喉嚨痛，吞東西的時候會痛。

swallow.en: to make food or drink go down your throat into your stomach

ex.en: A swallow flies very swiftly.
ex.zh: 燕子飛得非常快。

ex.en: In the autumn, swallows will fly south.
ex.zh: 到了秋天，燕子會往南飛。

swallow.en: a small bird with a forked tail that flies very fast

ex.en: The willow branches swayed gently in the breeze.
ex.zh: 柳枝在微風中輕輕搖曳。

ex.en: The crowd swayed to the music at the concert.
ex.zh: 演唱會上觀眾隨著音樂搖擺。

sway.en: to move slowly from side to side

ex.en: Don't let other people's opinions sway your decision.
ex.zh: 別讓別人的意見左右你的決定。

ex.en: His speech swayed many voters at the last minute.
ex.zh: 他的演講在最後一刻打動了許多選民。

sway.en: to change what someone thinks or decides

ex.en: Mary was a switchboard operator when she was younger.
ex.zh: 瑪麗年輕時當過總機接線員。

ex.en: Call the switchboard and ask for the HR department.
ex.zh: 打給總機，請他們轉人資部。

switchboard.en: a place in an office where phone calls are received and connected to the right people

ex.en: Sweat ran down his face after the long run.
ex.zh: 長跑之後，汗水順著他的臉流下。

ex.en: She wiped the sweat from her forehead with a towel.
ex.zh: 她用毛巾擦掉額頭上的汗。

ex.en: I always sweat a lot when I play basketball.
ex.zh: 我打籃球時總是流很多汗。

ex.en: Don't sweat the small stuff; everything will be fine.
ex.zh: 別為小事煩惱，一切都會沒事的。

ex.en: Swimming is a good exercise for the whole body.
ex.zh: 游泳是很好的全身運動。

ex.en: We go swimming at the pool every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我們每週六早上都去游泳池游泳。

ex.en: Swindon is a town in the south of England.
ex.zh: 史雲頓是英格蘭南部的一個城鎮。

ex.en: He takes the train from Swindon to London every day.
ex.zh: 他每天從史雲頓搭火車到倫敦。

ex.en: Sweden is a country in northern Europe.
ex.zh: 瑞典是北歐的一個國家。

ex.en: Stockholm is the capital of Sweden.
ex.zh: 斯德哥爾摩是瑞典的首都。

ex.en: Switzerland is a country in the middle of Europe.
ex.zh: 瑞士是位於歐洲中部的國家。

ex.en: Switzerland is famous for its mountains and chocolate.
ex.zh: 瑞士以山景和巧克力聞名。

ex.en: I bought a Swedish chair that was easy to put together.
ex.zh: 我買了一張很容易組裝的瑞典風格椅子。

ex.en: Swedish winters are long and dark.
ex.zh: 瑞典的冬天又長又黑暗。

ex.en: She is learning Swedish before she moves to Stockholm.
ex.zh: 她在搬去斯德哥爾摩之前正在學瑞典語。

ex.en: Swedish is the main language spoken in Sweden.
ex.zh: 瑞典語是瑞典主要使用的語言。

ex.en: Swiss watches are famous around the world.
ex.zh: 瑞士手錶聞名全世界。

ex.en: We took a Swiss train through the mountains.
ex.zh: 我們搭乘瑞士火車穿越群山。

ex.en: The Swiss are known for their chocolate and cheese.
ex.zh: 瑞士人以巧克力和起司聞名。

ex.en: A Swiss sat next to me on the plane and told me about Zurich.
ex.zh: 一位瑞士人在飛機上坐在我旁邊，跟我聊起蘇黎世。

sweeping.zh: 掃；橫掃（sweep 的現在分詞）

ex.en: He is sweeping the floor in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 他正在掃廚房的地板。

ex.en: A cold wind was sweeping across the empty field.
ex.zh: 一陣冷風正橫掃過空曠的田野。

ex.en: The school announced sweeping changes to the timetable.
ex.zh: 學校宣布了課表的全面調整。

ex.en: The new law brought sweeping reforms to the city.
ex.zh: 這項新法為這座城市帶來大幅度的改革。

ex.en: Saying that all teenagers are lazy is a sweeping statement.
ex.zh: 說所有青少年都懶惰是一種以偏概全的說法。

ex.en: Try not to make sweeping claims without proof.
ex.zh: 沒有證據時，盡量不要做籠統的斷言。

ex.en: The leaves swirled in the wind outside the door.
ex.zh: 門外的葉子在風中打著旋。

ex.en: She swirled the wine gently in her glass.
ex.zh: 她輕輕地在杯子裡轉動葡萄酒。

ex.en: Snow swirled around us as we walked up the hill.
ex.zh: 我們走上山坡時，雪在我們周圍打轉。

ex.en: A swirl of smoke rose from the campfire.
ex.zh: 一縷旋轉的煙從營火中升起。

ex.en: The artist painted a swirl of blue and white on the canvas.
ex.zh: 藝術家在畫布上畫了一道藍白相間的漩渦。

ex.en: A white swan floated quietly on the lake.
ex.zh: 一隻白天鵝靜靜地浮在湖面上。

ex.en: The swan spread its wings and flew away.
ex.zh: 天鵝展開翅膀飛走了。

ex.en: They were high school sweethearts and married after college.
ex.zh: 他們是高中時代的戀人，大學畢業後結了婚。

ex.en: He wrote a long letter to his sweetheart overseas.
ex.zh: 他寫了一封長信給遠在海外的心上人。

ex.en: Thanks for the tea, sweetheart.
ex.zh: 謝謝你泡的茶，親愛的。

ex.en: Could you pass me the salt, sweetheart?
ex.zh: 親愛的，可以把鹽遞給我嗎？

ex.en: She is a strong swimmer and crossed the lake easily.
ex.zh: 她游泳很強，輕鬆游過了湖。

ex.en: The swimmers waited for the whistle.
ex.zh: 游泳選手們等待哨聲響起。

ex.en: I was hot and sweaty after running up the hill.
ex.zh: 跑上山後，我又熱又滿身是汗。

ex.en: He wiped his sweaty hands on his jeans.
ex.zh: 他把汗濕的手在牛仔褲上擦了擦。

ex.en: A swarm of bees settled on the tree.
ex.zh: 一大群蜜蜂停在樹上。

ex.en: A swarm of reporters waited outside the hotel.
ex.zh: 一大群記者在飯店外等候。

ex.en: Fans swarmed around the singer as she left the stage.
ex.zh: 歌手下台時，歌迷蜂擁而上圍住她。

ex.en: Mosquitoes swarm near the water in summer.
ex.zh: 夏天水邊會有成群的蚊子飛舞。

ex.en: I like the sweetness of fresh strawberries.
ex.zh: 我喜歡新鮮草莓的甜味。

ex.en: The sweetness of her smile made everyone feel welcome.
ex.zh: 她笑容的甜美讓每個人都感到受歡迎。

ex.en: His ankle was swollen after the fall.
ex.zh: 他摔倒後腳踝腫了起來。

ex.en: The swollen river flooded the nearby fields.
ex.zh: 暴漲的河水淹沒了附近的農田。

ex.en: The eagle swooped down and caught a fish.
ex.zh: 老鷹俯衝而下，抓走了一條魚。

ex.en: Bats swoop over the pond at dusk.
ex.zh: 黃昏時蝙蝠會掠過池塘上空。

ex.en: The owl's swoop was silent and fast.
ex.zh: 貓頭鷹的俯衝安靜又迅速。

ex.en: Police made a swoop on the market early this morning.
ex.zh: 警方今天一早突擊搜查了這個市場。

ex.en: There is some swelling around his left ankle.
ex.zh: 他左腳踝周圍有些腫脹。

ex.en: Put ice on it to reduce the swelling.
ex.zh: 用冰敷來消腫。

ex.en: The swelling crowd filled the whole square.
ex.zh: 不斷增多的人群擠滿了整個廣場。

ex.en: The swelling river flooded the low fields.
ex.zh: 不斷上漲的河水淹沒了低窪的田地。

ex.en: A wide swath of forest was cleared for the road.
ex.zh: 為了築路，一大片森林被清除了。

ex.en: The storm cut a swath through the farmland.
ex.zh: 暴風雨在農田中掃出一道痕跡。

ex.en: I put on a warm sweatshirt because it was cold outside.
ex.zh: 外面很冷，所以我穿上一件保暖的運動衫。

ex.en: He wore a gray sweatshirt with a hood.
ex.zh: 他穿著一件有帽子的灰色運動衫。

ex.en: Come here, sweetie, and let me tie your shoes.
ex.zh: 過來，寶貝，我幫你綁鞋帶。

ex.en: Thanks for the coffee, sweetie.
ex.zh: 謝謝你的咖啡，親愛的。

ex.en: She swiveled in her chair to face me.
ex.zh: 她把椅子轉過來面對我。

ex.en: The camera can swivel to follow people as they move.
ex.zh: 這台攝影機能旋轉來追蹤移動的人。

ex.en: The chair sits on a swivel so it can turn all the way around.
ex.zh: 這張椅子裝在轉軸上，可以整個轉一圈。

ex.en: The lamp's swivel lets you point the light in any direction.
ex.zh: 燈的轉軸能讓你把光照向任何方向。

ex.en: The driver had to swerve to avoid a cat.
ex.zh: 駕駛得急轉彎來閃避一隻貓。

ex.en: The ball swerved to the left just before the goal.
ex.zh: 球在進門前突然往左偏。

ex.en: The car made a sudden swerve into the other lane.
ex.zh: 那輛車突然轉向切入另一條車道。

ex.en: His swerve saved us from hitting the fence.
ex.zh: 他的急轉彎讓我們沒撞上圍欄。

ex.en: A Swede won the first prize in the competition.
ex.zh: 一位瑞典人贏得了比賽的首獎。

ex.en: My roommate is a Swede who loves hiking.
ex.zh: 我的室友是個愛健行的瑞典人。

ex.en: The farmer raises swine and cattle on his farm.
ex.zh: 那位農夫在農場養豬和牛。

ex.en: Swine flu spread quickly in many countries in 2009.
ex.zh: 豬流感在2009年於許多國家迅速傳開。

ex.en: The children are swinging on the playground.
ex.zh: 孩子們正在遊樂場盪鞦韆。

ex.en: He walked in swinging his keys around his finger.
ex.zh: 他把鑰匙繞在手指上甩著走進來。

ex.en: London was famous as a swinging city in the 1960s.
ex.zh: 倫敦在六〇年代以時髦熱鬧的城市聞名。

ex.en: They went to a swinging party that lasted all night.
ex.zh: 他們去了一場通宵的熱鬧派對。

ex.en: The little girl smiled sweetly at the visitors.
ex.zh: 小女孩對訪客甜甜地笑著。

ex.en: The birds sang sweetly outside my window.
ex.zh: 鳥兒在我窗外悅耳地歌唱。

ex.en: She asked sweetly if she could borrow his pen.
ex.zh: 她客氣地問能不能借他的筆。

ex.en: I am switching to a new phone next month.
ex.zh: 我下個月要換新手機。

ex.en: She keeps switching between two apps.
ex.zh: 她一直在兩個應用程式之間切換。

ex.en: Don't forget to pack your swimsuit for the trip.
ex.zh: 別忘了把泳衣放進旅行的行李裡。

ex.en: She bought a blue swimsuit for the summer.
ex.zh: 她為夏天買了一件藍色泳衣。

ex.en: Swipe left to see the next photo.
ex.zh: 向左滑動就能看下一張照片。

ex.en: Please swipe your card at the gate.
ex.zh: 請在閘門刷卡。

ex.en: Someone swiped my pen from the desk.
ex.zh: 有人從桌上偷走了我的筆。

ex.en: He swiped a cookie when no one was looking.
ex.zh: 趁沒人注意，他偷拿了一塊餅乾。

ex.en: The cat took a swipe at the dog.
ex.zh: 那隻貓朝狗揮了一爪。

ex.en: He took a swipe at the ball and missed.
ex.zh: 他揮棒擊球卻沒打中。

ex.en: She swathed the baby in a soft blanket.
ex.zh: 她用柔軟的毯子把寶寶包起來。

ex.en: The patient's arm was swathed in bandages.
ex.zh: 病人的手臂被繃帶層層纏住。

ex.en: He swatted the fly with a newspaper.
ex.zh: 他用報紙拍打那隻蒼蠅。

ex.en: She swatted the mosquito on her arm.
ex.zh: 她拍死了手臂上的蚊子。

ex.en: With one swat, he killed the bug.
ex.zh: 他一拍就打死了那隻蟲。

ex.en: The cat gave the toy a quick swat.
ex.zh: 貓對玩具快速拍了一下。

ex.en: She likes to sweeten her tea with a spoonful of honey.
ex.zh: 她喜歡在茶裡加一匙蜂蜜增甜。

ex.en: You can sweeten the sauce with a little sugar.
ex.zh: 你可以加一點糖讓醬汁變甜。

ex.en: The company sweetened the offer with a signing bonus.
ex.zh: 公司用簽約獎金讓這個條件更有吸引力。

ex.en: A few kind words sweetened his mood.
ex.zh: 幾句好話讓他的心情好了些。

ex.en: He walked in with a confident swagger.
ex.zh: 他自信滿滿、大搖大擺地走進來。

ex.en: There was a swagger in his voice after the win.
ex.zh: 贏了之後，他的語氣裡帶著得意。

ex.en: The winner swaggered across the stage.
ex.zh: 優勝者大搖大擺地走過舞台。

ex.en: He swaggered into the room as if he owned it.
ex.zh: 他大搖大擺走進房間，彷彿那是他的地盤。

ex.en: We heard the swish of her long skirt as she walked by.
ex.zh: 她走過時，我們聽到長裙發出的沙沙聲。

ex.en: The ball went through the net with a clean swish.
ex.zh: 球乾淨俐落地唰一聲入網。

ex.en: The horse swished its tail to chase away the flies.
ex.zh: 那匹馬甩動尾巴趕走蒼蠅。

ex.en: The curtains swished open and bright light filled the room.
ex.zh: 窗簾唰地被拉開，明亮的光線灑滿房間。

ex.en: The street sweeper starts work before sunrise.
ex.zh: 街道清掃員在日出前就開始工作。

ex.en: A sweeper cleans the hallway every evening.
ex.zh: 每天傍晚都有清掃人員打掃走廊。

ex.en: The city bought a new sweeper to clean the roads.
ex.zh: 市政府買了一台新的清道車來清潔道路。

ex.en: This carpet sweeper picks up crumbs without electricity.
ex.zh: 這台地毯掃除器不用電就能掃起碎屑。

swirling.zh: 打轉；旋轉（swirl 的現在分詞）

ex.en: Leaves were swirling around in the wind.
ex.zh: 樹葉在風中打著轉。

ex.en: She watched the cream swirling in her coffee.
ex.zh: 她看著奶精在咖啡裡打轉。

ex.en: The swirling of the river made the boat hard to steer.
ex.zh: 河水的漩渦讓船很難操控。

ex.en: I could see a gentle swirling of snow outside the window.
ex.zh: 我看得到窗外雪花輕輕地旋舞。

ex.en: The report exposed a sweatshop that paid workers very little.
ex.zh: 這份報導揭露了一家給工人極低薪資的血汗工廠。

ex.en: Many shoppers try to avoid clothes made in a sweatshop.
ex.zh: 許多消費者會盡量避免買血汗工廠製造的衣服。

ex.en: I put an artificial sweetener in my coffee instead of sugar.
ex.zh: 我在咖啡裡加代糖而不是砂糖。

ex.en: This soda uses a natural sweetener made from a plant.
ex.zh: 這種汽水用的是從植物提煉的天然甜味劑。

ex.en: Some people think the sweetener leaves a strange aftertaste.
ex.zh: 有些人覺得這種代糖會留下奇怪的餘味。

ex.en: He was sweating after running up the stairs.
ex.zh: 他跑上樓梯後汗流浹背。

ex.en: I was sweating all night because the room was so hot.
ex.zh: 房間太熱，我整晚都在流汗。

ex.en: Excessive sweating can be a sign of nervousness.
ex.zh: 過度流汗可能是緊張的徵兆。

ex.en: Sweating helps your body cool down.
ex.zh: 流汗能幫助身體降溫。

ex.en: We grilled a swordfish steak for dinner.
ex.zh: 我們晚餐烤了一片旗魚排。

ex.en: The swordfish is known for its long, flat bill.
ex.zh: 旗魚以牠長而扁平的吻部聞名。

ex.en: Fans began to swoon when the singer walked on stage.
ex.zh: 歌手一走上舞台，粉絲就開始神魂顛倒。

ex.en: In old novels, a lady would swoon at bad news.
ex.zh: 在老小說裡，女士聽到壞消息就會昏厥過去。

ex.en: She fell into a swoon in the hot, crowded room.
ex.zh: 她在悶熱擁擠的房間裡昏了過去。

ex.en: He caught her just as she went into a swoon.
ex.zh: 她昏厥的那一刻，他剛好接住了她。

ex.en: He swigged water from the bottle after the run.
ex.zh: 跑完步後，他對著瓶口大口灌水。

ex.en: She swigged her juice and hurried out the door.
ex.zh: 她大口喝完果汁就匆匆出門。

ex.en: He took a long swig of cold lemonade.
ex.zh: 他大大地喝了一口冰檸檬水。

ex.en: Have a swig of this; it will warm you up.
ex.zh: 喝一大口這個，會讓你暖和起來。

ex.en: The nurse used a cotton swab to clean the small cut.
ex.zh: 護理師用棉花棒清理那個小傷口。

ex.en: The doctor took a throat swab to test for infection.
ex.zh: 醫生採了喉嚨拭子來檢查是否感染。

ex.en: The sailors swabbed the deck every morning.
ex.zh: 水手們每天早上擦洗甲板。

ex.en: The nurse swabbed my arm before the injection.
ex.zh: 護理師在打針前擦拭了我的手臂。

ex.en: She picked up a swatch of blue fabric to match the sofa.
ex.zh: 她拿了一塊藍色布樣來搭配沙發。

ex.en: The store gave us a paint swatch to take home.
ex.zh: 店家給了我們一張油漆色卡帶回家。

ex.en: It was a sweltering afternoon in July.
ex.zh: 那是七月一個悶熱的下午。

ex.en: We stayed inside to escape the sweltering heat.
ex.zh: 我們待在室內躲避悶熱的天氣。

swearing.zh: 罵髒話（swear 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The coach was angry at the players for swearing during practice.
ex.zh: 教練對球員在練習中說髒話感到很生氣。

ex.en: Stop swearing in front of the children.
ex.zh: 別在孩子面前罵髒話。

ex.en: He stood in court swearing to tell the truth.
ex.zh: 他站在法庭上宣誓會說實話。

ex.en: She kept swearing that she had locked the door.
ex.zh: 她一直發誓說自己有鎖門。

ex.en: Do you want to swop seats with me?
ex.zh: 你要不要跟我換座位？

ex.en: The boys swop trading cards at school.
ex.zh: 男孩們在學校交換卡片。

ex.en: It was a fair swop: my book for your magazine.
ex.zh: 這是公平的交換：我的書換你的雜誌。

ex.en: They did a swop of houses for the summer holiday.
ex.zh: 他們暑假時互換了房子住。

ex.en: I prefer tea without sweetened milk.
ex.zh: 我喜歡不加甜牛奶的茶。

ex.en: The label says this drink is sweetened with honey.
ex.zh: 標籤上寫這款飲料是用蜂蜜加甜的。

ex.en: The road climbs the mountain in a series of tight switchbacks.
ex.zh: 這條路以一連串急彎的之字形盤上山。

ex.en: We rested at a switchback halfway up the trail.
ex.zh: 我們在步道半途的一個轉折處休息。

ex.en: The swampy ground made it hard to walk.
ex.zh: 沼澤般的地面讓人很難行走。

ex.en: Mosquitoes love the swampy areas near the river.
ex.zh: 蚊子很喜歡河邊的沼澤地帶。

ex.en: Please switch off the lights when you leave.
ex.zh: 離開時請把燈關掉。

ex.en: He switched off the TV and went to bed.
ex.zh: 他關了電視就去睡覺了。

switch off.en: to stop a machine or light by using a switch

ex.en: I switched off during the long meeting.
ex.zh: 那場冗長的會議中，我就放空了。

ex.en: Kids often switch off when the lesson is boring.
ex.zh: 課很無聊時，孩子常常會放空。

ex.en: Could you switch on the heater? It's freezing.
ex.zh: 可以把暖氣打開嗎？冷死了。

ex.en: She switched on the lamp and began to read.
ex.zh: 她打開檯燈開始看書。

switch on.en: to start a machine or light by using a switch

ex.en: I switched to a new phone plan last month.
ex.zh: 我上個月換了新的手機方案。

ex.en: Let's switch to a different topic.
ex.zh: 我們換個話題吧。

switch to.en: to change from one thing to another
